# The "compiler" here is run-refl2952.cmd, not dxc.exe: the report is about what
# a reflection container can tell an application, and dxc.exe never calls
# ID3D12LibraryReflection. The harness compiles this source with the DXC under
# test, then walks the reflection interfaces an application has and, separately,
# reads the container's RDAT part with DXC's own RDAT reader.
#
# lib_6_3 is the oldest library profile in the release sequence and is DXR 1.0,
# per SKILL.md's "target the repro at the oldest profile and flag set that still
# shows the symptom". No other flags: the issue reports none, and it names no
# configuration at all.
-T lib_6_3 repro.hlsl
